reading: L17: «فأما عز» as printed. The letters are clear, but عز gives no sense before «جذر مائتين الا عشرة»; the parallel heading of the next demonstration (frame 049, L10) reads «وأما علة جذر مائتين». Whether the print has a wrong sort or a different word was intended is not known; the editors do not comment.

L06: «وهو نصف سدس فى ثلث», as printed. The letters are clear. نصف سدس, a twelfth, is the quantity that the problem of L05 asks for (four times its square equal to a third of it: 4x·x = x/3, x = 1/12, as the editors' note (١) also gives); what «فى ثلث» adds is not clear, and the editors do not comment.
